_comment: Forecasting targets for forecast_eval.py: 3-character ICD-10 codes per target, fixed before looking at results. A patient is a case at the first recorded code of the group. Pregnancy codes (O10-O16, O24) are left out on purpose, as are hereditary/aplastic/acute blood-loss anaemias (D55-D62). Kidney = chronic kidney disease (N18) plus unspecified renal failure (N19), without acute kidney injury (N17): AKI is mostly acquired and coded within an admission from that admission's creatinine, so months-ahead forecasting is not a meaningful question for it.
